vibe_rationale: Surf, art, film and music festival with a real ocean-culture core since 2005, but larger and more commercial than SURPLUS at 150,000 visitors with international headline acts.
fit_notes: Ocean wellness and conservation framing (Save The Ocean) suits a health brand, and the art and film strands suit a lounge or recovery space. Booth enquiries go through a public contact page, but no sponsor list is published and cost is high at this scale. Japan-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
